note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web. The only official parcel viewer is the GCT GeoPortal atlas at atlas.geoportalmaps.com/ptcoupee, a web viewer with no discoverable public REST endpoint; its services.geoportalmaps.com and atlas ArcGIS REST roots return 404. The assessor site links only to that viewer and an assessor search page. ArcGIS Online items for Pointe Coupee are non-parcel (streets, address points, flood, land claims). Commercial parcel sellers (Regrid, Dynamo, Acres, landrecords.us) are paid and do not qualify.
